match_stages.stage_briefing:
8x3 Trigger Freeze is a 24 round, 120-point, Comstock Classifier course. There are 12 USPSA targets.

The handgun start position is anywhere in shooting area with handgun loaded and holstered and wrists below belt.

The PCC start position is anywhere in shooting area, PCC loaded with safety on, stock on belt, muzzle generally down-range.

On the audible start signal, engage targets as they become available from within the shooting area.
